name: Wash the Car 🧽
desc:
Wash Cars 🚗. Make 💵💰🤑.

🧽 Scrub dirty cars until they shine
💵 Earn cash for every car you wash
🫧 Build foam arches, brushes, water jets and dryers
🏎️ Wash rarer cars, from rusty junkers to supercars
🚁 Wash helicopters, boats and planes
🚀 Wash the %^REDACTED*$!

❓ Did you know... Some cars leave a tip if you wash them fast! 💸

👍 Like the game and join our community to receive absolutely nothing at all!*
*Except for the knowledge that you made the developers very happy. :)

llm.loop: scrub dirty cars -> earn cash -> build foam arches, brushes, jets and dryers -> wash rarer vehicles
llm.objectives: wash rarer vehicles up to supercars, aircraft and a secret item
llm.progression: car-wash equipment, vehicle rarity tiers (junkers to supercars, helicopters, boats, planes)
llm.instructions: scrub cars to shine, earn cash, build foam arches, brushes, water jets and dryers, wash rarer vehicles
unique: satisfying cleaning loop combined with luck-based rarer car spawns
llm.thumbnails: red supercar half dirty, half sparkling inside a car-wash arch
llm.complexity_notes: dirt/scrub masking system plus tycoon building and many vehicle models
